name: Fahmi Fadzil
_note: M2 cohort: federal cabinet minister, in cabinet since 3 Dec 2022 (Communications and Digital, then Communications from the Dec 2023 split). Data on file; below ranking validity pending further objective dimensions and the Layer B panel.

metrics.justification: No corruption charge or conviction of record. A review of court and anti-corruption records to the source date found no personal matter against the minister. Recorded as the subject's own factual status only.
